items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: I used Tate bass for the next street night, blind Tate.

ctx.x: How did you keep up with it? I mean, physically, how did you...

Yeah, that's what I'm saying. Well, I just jested myself and he said, well, that wasn't too bad, man. So what happened? They had blisters rolled up on my fingers, on both fingers, with blisters, you know. Oh, man. And there's a lot of, you know, like that water coming in you. And so, man, I took a pen and I busted. I said, well, Lord, I said, I've got to play tomorrow night in my hands in this condition, you know? And I said to myself, well, I guess I've got to play until I get the calluses, you know. So what…
